newsitem.title: USA: CCB Fin'l, Salem Trust revise merger terms.
newsitem.headline: CCB Fin'l, Salem Trust revise merger terms.

text.p: CCB Financial Corp and Salem Trust Bank of Winston-Salem, N.C. said they have agreed to revise their acquisition terms.
The revised terms of the agreement are as follows:

- If the average closing price of CCB Financial common stock for the sixty trading days prior to the scheduled closing date is $46.78 to $57.18, the exchange ratio will remain fixed at .41 share of CCB Financial common stock for one share of Salem Trust common stock;
- If the average closing price is greater than $57.18, the exchange ratio will be adjusted ratably downward from .41; or
- If the average closing price is less than $46.78, the exchange ratio will be adjusted ratably upward from .41.

"We are delighted to have reached revised acquisition terms with Salem Trust," said E.C. Roessler, CCB President and Chief Executive Officer. "The revised terms will allow both parties to benefit in the recent rise in the price of our stock."
